text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur... chatter, chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the GⅠ Hanshin JF had arrived. 
Even before the race, an extraordinary 
fervor hung in the air over the venue. The 
spectators' main focus was, of course—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how the Hanshin JF will turn 
out~! Oh man, I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The girls running in this race are mostly 
aiming for the Triple Tiara route. We've 
got an amazing lineup of charming 
contenders this year too~

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"The ones who win here often go on to be 
the stars of the Classic Class! Let's keep 
our eyes peeled on them."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Whoa... The excitement here is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To think I get to run in this field... My 
moms back home must be so surprised.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I feel the immense weight of 
expectations for a GⅠ. To think Nishino 
Flower will be running in this feverish 
atmosphere... Just imagining it fills me 
with overwhelming tension.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was I able to properly relieve her fatigue 
up to today? If she were to get injured—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: L-Let's head to the waiting room!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me, coming through on the side! 
Hurry up and carry it!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond just the spectators, you could feel 
the whole racetrack being more on edge 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks so busy... I hope they're 
doing okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it doesn't seem to have 
affected Nishino Flower. Just as I was 
thinking that...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, please watch me. I worked so 
hard to reach this stage, I'm definitely 
going to win!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Don't put so much pressure on yourself. 
You'll be fine. Out of all the girls I've 
raised, you are strong. I'm the one saying 
it. You believe me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list:
(If only I had that much experience 
too...)

(If only I had that much experience, 
too...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Junior Class, there's barely any 
gap in experience between the Umamusume. 
Therefore, the trainer's own experience 
could end up making the difference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only I had met her after becoming more 
capable as a Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Why did it have to be "now," I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Ah... Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone seems so much more confident 
than me... So wonderful, and so cool.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm... just a 'kid,' after all, 
aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm smaller than anyone else, and my body 
feels so fragile... But even so, to run 
just like everyone else... I just don't 
have the confidence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Uma Musume who matters deeply to me is 
anxious right by my side. Failing to 
notice that and moping around makes me a 
failure as a Trainer, no matter how much 
experience I have.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Your hard work, Trainer, is what helps me 
grow so much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower, who acknowledged her. The 
one who knows her hard work better than 
anyone and acknowledges her true strength 
is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She certainly has a young body. Even so, 
she skipped grades to enroll at Tracen 
Academy. That's not something just anyone 
could do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's the greatest proof that she 
possesses something extraordinary enough 
to overcome any handicap. That's why...!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I believe in you...!!
It's okay, I believe in you...!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right... That's how it was. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. When you said "it's okay" just 
now... it sounded so reassuring... I feel 
so relieved.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I... will definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I will present you with victory as a 
gift...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “It's okay, I believe in you...!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “It's okay, I believe in you...!!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's voice was trembling. I mean... 
of course it was.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(This is Trainer's first GⅠ race too... We 
share the same anxiety.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... look at me. Only thinking 
about myself...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Why did it have to be 'now'? If my growth 
spurt had come when I was bigger... I 
could encourage Trainer with confidence."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(That's not something I should be thinking 
about right now. I want to give Trainer 
confidence. That's why I chose today. 
That's why...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —I want to win.
